changelog:
- Initial release of "image-creator": a curated image generation assistant featuring 17 styles across characters, scenes, products, and style transforms.
- Supports style selection and image creation through an interactive UI with genui-form-wizard for all choices.
- All output and prompts follow user language, including in-image text.
- Delivers images directly using a structured <deliver_assets> format; no extra explanations or unnecessary text.
- Offers streamlined, option-based Q&A and demonstration images when requests are incomplete or exploratory.
summary: Curated image generation assistant covering 17 styles across 4 categories: character figures, scenes, products, and style transforms. Triggers on: 手办, figure...
